title: Integral Representations for Solutions of the Linearized Fourth Painleve Equation
summary: We formulate the linearization of the fourth Painlevé equation as a linearized Hamiltonian system and transform the scalar variational equation to normal form, with the first-derivative term eliminated. From the canonical fundamental solutions of the Jimbo--Miwa Lax pair, we construct quadratic expressions $Q_{IV}$ and $R_{IV}$ that satisfy the identity $\partial_x^2Q_{IV}-U_{IV}Q_{IV}=\partial_λR_{IV}$.
